acquisition_method.evidence: An Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid (Thermo Fisher) mass spectrometer was operated in a data-dependent mode and TMT reporter ions were quantified using a synchronous precursor selection-based MS3 technology, as previously described.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were adjusted to 16 mM TCEP, incubated for 30 min @ RT to reduce disulfide bonds, and subsequently alkylated by addition of 35 mM iodoacetamide and incubation for 30 min @ RT.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Samples were adjusted to 16 mM TCEP, incubated for 30 min @ RT to reduce disulfide bonds, and subsequently alkylated by addition of 35 mM iodoacetamide and incubation for 30 min @ RT.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were diluted with 1.5 volumes of digestion buffer (50 mM Tris/HCl pH 8.6, 5 mM CaCl2), acetonitrile (ACN) was added to a final concentration of 5%, as well as Lys-C at a 50:1 ratio of protein/enzyme and incubated for 4 h at 37 °C.
Samples were then diluted with one volume of digestion buffer and trypsin was added at a 50:1 ratio as above, and samples were incubated overnight at 37 °C.

fractionation_method.evidence: TMT labeled peptides were offline fractionated at high pH on a YMC Triart C18 0.5 × 250 mm column (YMC Europe GmbH) using the Agilent 1100 system (Agilent Technologies).

fragmentation_method.evidence: In brief, the top 20 most intense precursor ions from the Orbitrap survey scan were selected for collision-induced dissociation (CID) fragmentation.
